summary: nerolation 澄清 EIP-7976 与 EIP-7981，把下限成本明确为每个 calldata 或访问列表字节 64 gas，当天提交并合并。benaadams 的 EIP-8141 规范收紧合并。Magicians 上出现基于 EIP-5792 的钱包隐私 paymaster 能力草案。koeppelmann 就 CowSwap 前端被入侵表态，认为用户进入恶意界面的事情还会继续发生。

items.topic: 交易与 gas：EIP-7976 与 EIP-7981
items.title: EIP-7976：澄清 token 抽象
items.note: （nerolation）提交并合并：把 EIP-7976 与 EIP-7981 的下限成本明确为每个 calldata 或访问列表字节 64 gas（每个地址 1280 gas，每个存储键 2048 gas），token 抽象仅为与 EIP-7623 保持一致而保留。
items.note_en: (nerolation), submitted and merged: the floor cost in EIP-7976 and EIP-7981 is stated as 64 gas per calldata or access list byte (1280 gas per address, 2048 gas per storage key), with the token abstraction kept only for consistency with EIP-7623.

summary_en: nerolation clarified EIP-7976 and EIP-7981 by making the floor cost explicit at 64 gas per calldata or access list byte, submitted and merged the same day. benaadams's EIP-8141 spec tightening was merged. A draft wallet privacy paymaster capability built on EIP-5792 appeared on Magicians. koeppelmann addressed the CowSwap interface compromise, saying users landing on malicious interfaces will keep happening.
